title: Gorilla in the Studio

properties.Credit: Directed and filmed by Smart Chen
properties.Media status: 10 of 10 photographs imported as native Notion files; all original carousel photographs recovered.
properties.Subtitle: 摄影棚里的猩猩

markdown:
<columns>
	<column ratio="40">
		A group of emory university photographers
		Captured photos of a gorilla
		In the forest next to visual arts building
		They gave him a printed photo as gift
		This happened last week
		This is the first gorilla to appreciate human art
		He didn’t make it out, but he made history
	</column>
	<column ratio="60">
		<video src="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XxxAH3dHbOo"></video>
		Director's cut: [https://youtu.be/UpbR9fmthpY](https://youtu.be/UpbR9fmthpY)
		Watch on Bilibili:
	</column>
</columns>
